data.content:
Implementation plan (planning step, knot 42e7)

## Evidence gathered
- src/rollback.rs:104 `rollback_target` hardcodes action -> immediately
  preceding queue state; there is no failure-outcome path.
- src/workflow_runtime.rs:112 `next_outcome_state` ALREADY resolves a named
  failure outcome against the installed bundle's per-action failure map, but
  grep shows it is only referenced by src/loom_compat_harness.rs:291 and
  tests. It is not wired to any CLI command. This is the missing plumbing.
- loom/work_sdlc/dist/bundle.json DOES carry shipment `outcomes`
  (merge_conflicts -> ready_for_implementation, ci_failure ->
  ready_for_implementation, release_blocked -> blocked); only the rendered
  prompt BODY lost the `## Failure Modes` section. Rebuilding with
  `make loom-bundle` (loom 0.3.0 present) restores it, so dist is simply
  stale vs loom/work_sdlc/prompts/shipment.md. Verified by diffing a fresh
  `loom build` against the checked-in bundle.
- src/write_dispatch/execute/execute_write_ops.rs:353 rollback calls
  set_state then release_bound_lease (two separately locked writes);
  src/app/knot_lease.rs:18 set_lease_id and src/lease.rs:67 terminate_lease
  each take their own FileLock, and src/locks.rs FileLock is NOT reentrant.
- src/app/helpers.rs:419 `apply_step_transition` always closes the active
  step record as `Completed`; there is no Failed/Aborted close path.
- src/app/state_ops.rs:241 `write_state_change_locked` re-writes
  `lease_id: current.lease_id`, so it cannot unbind in the same upsert.

## Chosen design
Extend `kno rollback` with `--outcome <name>` (plus `--lease <id>`) rather
than adding a new verb. Flag-absent behavior is byte-identical, satisfying
AC5, and the command already owns "action state -> earlier queue state".

Surface:
  kno rollback <id> --outcome merge_conflicts --lease <LEASE_ID>
                    [--dry-run] [--json] [--actor-kind agent]

## Steps
1. src/failure_outcome.rs (new module)
   - `resolve_failure_outcome(app, id, outcome) -> FailureResolution`
     { knot, outcome, target_state, requires_force, owner_kind }.
   - Reuse rollback's action-state guards (extract
     `require_rollback_state` / `reject_invalid_rollback_state` into a
     shared pub(crate) helper so queue/terminal/passive rejection stays
     identical to generic rollback).
   - Resolve target via workflow_runtime::next_outcome_state.
   - Reject: unknown outcome name; success outcomes (must use `kno next`);
     any caller-supplied target state (no free-form force mutation).

2. Atomic transition + lease release
   - src/app/state_fail_ops.rs (new): `App::fail_state_transition(id,
     target_state, actor, lease_id)` acquiring repo+cache FileLocks ONCE
     and performing, inside that single locked section:
       a. state change to target with lease_id cleared in the same
          upsert_knot_hot;
       b. active step record closed with StepStatus::Failed, to_state =
          target (from_state stays the queue state that opened the step,
          e.g. ready_for_shipment) and lease-sourced actor preserved;
       c. bound lease knot terminated (or returned to lease_ready for MCP
          session leases, mirroring lease_guard::release_bound_lease).
   - Mechanics: give `write_state_change_locked` an options struct
     (cascade + `clear_lease: bool` + `step_close: StepCloseKind`) instead
     of growing its parameter list; add
     `apply_step_failure_transition` beside src/app/helpers.rs:419.
   - No `update -> next -> rollback` and no manual lease surgery.

3. CLI + dispatch
   - src/cli_agent.rs RollbackArgs: add `--outcome`, `--lease`.
   - src/write_dispatch/operation_map.rs map_rollback: carry both through
     RollbackOperation (src/write_queue).
   - src/write_dispatch/execute/execute_write_ops.rs execute_rollback:
     branch to the failure path when `--outcome` is set; validate the lease
     with the same lease_guard path `next` uses; keep dry-run + JSON output
     shapes, adding `outcome` to the JSON payload.

4. Prompts + bundle parity
   - Rewrite `## Failure Modes` in loom/work_sdlc/prompts/shipment.md (and
     the sibling prompts that declare failure outcomes) to the exact new
     command, replacing the incomplete `kno update --status` advice.
   - Regenerate with `make loom-bundle`.
   - New parity test (src/loom_bundle_parity_tests.rs): for every
     loom/work_sdlc/prompts/*.md, assert (a) frontmatter `failure:` map ==
     bundle prompt `outcomes` with is_success=false, and (b) the source
     `## Failure Modes` block text appears in the compiled bundle body.
     Pure file comparison, so CI needs no loom binary.

5. Tests (map 1:1 to the knot's verification list)
   - tests/cli_rollback_outcome.rs: work knot in `shipment` with an active
     bound lease -> `--outcome merge_conflicts` leaves it in
     ready_for_implementation, lease_id null, lease knot lease_terminated.
   - Step-history assertion: shipment step status failed, from_state
     ready_for_shipment, to_state ready_for_implementation, lease-sourced
     agent identity retained.
   - Rejection: undeclared outcome name and success outcome both error and
     leave state + lease_id + lease state unchanged.
   - Regression: bare `kno rollback` still rejects queue states and still
     rewinds shipment -> ready_for_shipment.
   - Unit tests in src/failure_outcome.rs for resolution/rejection.

6. Docs + release hygiene
   - docs/leases.md and skills/knots*.md rollback references updated where
     they describe failure handling.
   - Add a changeset (patch) describing the new flag.
   - `make sanity` (fmt, lint, size limits, tests, coverage >= 95). Do not
     lower .ci/coverage-threshold.txt.

## Risks
- File-size ceiling (500 lines): state_ops.rs is already 437 lines, so the
  failure path goes in a new module rather than being appended.
- `write_state_change_locked` signature change touches the cascade path;
  keep the options struct defaulted so existing call sites are mechanical.
- FileLock is non-reentrant: every lease mutation in the atomic path must
  use *_locked helpers, never the public App methods.
- Coverage ratchet at 95 — new branches need direct unit coverage.

## Complexity
Medium-high. ~6 source modules touched, 2 new modules, 1 bundle
regeneration, ~8 new tests. No child knots required; the work is one
coherent change set and splitting it would break the atomicity guarantee
being tested.
